The Arima Kinen――On the stage of this 
generational clash, the "Golden 
Generation," led by Special Week, make 
their appearance.

Narita Top Road takes on the challenge. 
The moment she steps into the paddock, a 
roar of cheers envelops her like an 
earthquake.

Narita Top Road has always brought light 
to those around her. This was the path 
they walked together—a path woven of 
light.

A light that was once small now shines 
brightly enough to dazzle everyone, racing 
along the road to the summit!
